name: When do I need a property assessment for my tiny home?

mainEntity.name: When do I need a property assessment for my tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: You typically need a property assessment for your tiny home when purchasing or selling, applying for a mortgage or refinancing, or obtaining insurance. Assessments are also crucial for determining accurate property taxes or if you're disputing a tax valuation. If you plan to move your tiny home, an assessment might be required by lenders or insurers to understand its value in different locations, especially if it's considered a chattel rather than real property.
acceptedAnswer.description: You need a tiny home assessment when buying, selling, refinancing, insuring, or for property tax purposes.
